summary: Confirmed 2026 rates $40 (water/electric) to $50 (full hookup), water and sewer hookups. Added 50-amp electric (full-hookup sites 30 or 50), laundry and store, season mid-April to mid-October (no exact dates), reservable by phone/email. Site count (180, from the note) not stated on the operator's pages; showers not stated (only 'bath house').
flags: Criteria check (seasonal-park rule): the operator's About page says the campground 'is made up of mostly Seasonal Campers with the exception of a few weekend RV/tent sites for visitors', and the transient offer is worded as 'Want to come for a Weekend?'. Whether 1 in 10 sites are sold nightly is not stated; a human should apply the five-test seasonal rule.

Waterfront re-audit lead: the About page says 'Our campground also has a creek that runs through the heart of it so grab a tube and enjoy floating down creek' and lists '2 Ponds for Catch and Release Fishing'; the entry is 'not waterfront'.
